bullets.text: Moved 9 services to Kubernetes on AWS with Terraform, cutting deploy time from 30 to 8 minutes.

Ran the weekly on-call review and mentored 3 junior developers.
Wrote Python and Airflow pipelines loading 40 GB a day into Snowflake.
